Name: System Overview
Description: The system shall provide core functionality for vehicle control

Name: Propulsion Control
Description: The system shall control propulsion motor based on throttle input

Name: Brake Control
Description: The system shall apply brakes when brake pedal is pressed

Name: Sensor Integration
Description: The system shall integrate with temperature and pressure sensors

Name: CAN Communication
Description: The system shall communicate over CAN bus at 500kbps

Name: Safety Watchdog
Description: The system shall implement a hardware watchdog with 100ms timeout
